summary: Reply to the first person on the waiting list, offering the free plot near the greenhouse. Plain text, as it will be sent.
doc:
Hello Sam,

thank you for your message and for waiting so patiently. A standard plot near the greenhouse has become free, number 23. It gets sun from late morning and is two steps from the new water tap.

The season fee is €60 and covers water, tools and the compost delivery. If you would like the plot, just reply to this message by the end of next week. We will then send you the key code for the shed and the dates of the next working Saturday.

If 23 is not right for you, you stay at the top of the waiting list, of course.

Best wishes from the garden,
Mira for the garden team
